requirements.statement: It looks like a pigeon: a chubby, cute city pigeon
It sounds like a pigeon: the same frequency as a city/feral pigeon's coo, matched to the loudest part of the coo, about 340 Hz rising to about 470 Hz
It can be 3D printed on my FDM printer with a 0.4 mm nozzle in PLA or PETG; I can print high quality for smoother air chambers
One finger hole for the 'roo': rocking a finger over it gives the rolling coo-roo-coo
It is a toy, gift or desk piece: fun to blow and recognisably pigeon-ish; it does not have to fool a bird
